verdict.rationale: Sill is a Mac-to-iPhone/iPad remote screen app. Products of this kind could publish an API, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no API spec: probes of every standard OpenAPI/Swagger path on getsill.app returned 404, and nothing in the docs or repo mentions a machine-readable API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
